newsitem.title: USA: Dresser wins North Sea drilling contract.
newsitem.headline: Dresser wins North Sea drilling contract.

text.p: Dresser Industries Inc said Tuesday divisions of its Drilling and Production Operations have been awarded major contracts with Elf Exploration UK plc for the development of their high temperature, high pressure Elgin and Franklin Fields in the North Sea, some 80 miles (130km) east of Aberdeen, Scotland.
Development drilling for the Elgin/Franklin Project is expected to last up to 4-1/2 years, during which time the drilling and completion of at least 10 wells is anticipated, Dresser said.
It said the value of the Elf Aquitaine unit's contracts is expected to be in the order of 30 million pounds ($50 million).

Dresser said its Baroid division will provide Drilling and Completion Fluids Services and its Sperry-Sun Drilling Services division, supported by its Security DBS affiliate, was chosen to provide integrated drilling services for this project.

The technology supplied for this project will perform in wells where reservoir pressures and temperatures are expected to exceed 1,103 bar (16,000 psi) and 205 C (400 F), respectively, at depths of more than 5,600 meters (18,000 feet), Dresser said.
